## v0.1.2 — Launcher polish + 30/60 FPS

Fresh Windows x64 package. **BYO ISO** — no game files inside.

### Changes
- Frame rate limited to **30** or **60** (higher rates make UE3 gameplay look accelerated)
- Soft fog/particle edges (`use_fuzzy_alpha_epsilon`) on by default
- Keyboard remapping when mouse & keyboard mode is on
- Host cursor hidden in pad-only play
- RelWithDebInfo only (`rexruntimerd.dll` / `rexgpu-xenosrd.dll`)

### What's included
- Saw2Launcher.exe
- saw2.exe + RelWithDebInfo runtime DLLs
- extract-xiso.exe
- README.txt / BUILD.txt

### You need
- Own Saw II Xbox 360 ISO (`4B4E0822`)
- .NET 8 Desktop Runtime
- Vulkan GPU
